name: Azeroth Companion
title: Loot Hunter — Acquisition Library & Farm Planner
features: Add Loot Hunter studio with a curated, sourced acquisition guide library for legacy Warcraft collectibles
Track farm goals, number of attempts, acquired status, personal notes and per-item quest steps
Import saved Blizzard Item Codex wishlist entries into the farming board without falsely claiming their drop sources
Open tracked items in the existing live Blizzard Item Codex
Import/export farming plans as portable JSON backups; preserve all v2.1 features and saved records
Display verified third-party acquisition references separately from official Blizzard item information
